key_points.point: The document proposes an outcome-based regulatory framework that shifts the burden of proof to model providers. By using 'regulation mechanisms' as a form of market license, it allows providers to bet on their model's performance rather than requiring intrusive white-box access. Instead of trying to prove 'This model is unsafe', the regulator now judges, 'Is the model provider willing to bet their own capital on the model's safety?'
